items.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023
items.q: So I recall Dexter Gordon was there playing and you know a spring broke on his horn and he needed a rubber band and I just happened to have a rubber band with me you

ctx.x: Yeah. They were all encouraging me to do that because like back then you had like the apprenticeship and so on, where all you had to do was show someone that you wanted to know something from that you were interested and they would take you on and show you like how to do it you know. And so yeah, yeah, it was that kind of environment like in Chicago you know. And so it was all there in a way you know. The off nights it was local musicians and sessions and stuff, but then on the weekend you’d have the big players…
know, so I gave him that. I mean I guess the next time I saw Dexter was like when the Art Ensemble went to Europe, so he was there in Copenhagen.
